pilot: BlockGroup_9_n2 inspected for schema and first three processed rows. All comparisons are exploratory fixed-geometry tests, not untouched blind validation.
prediction: Parameter-free ideal Housner angular speed ratio 1 - 1.5*B^2/(B^2+H^2), using only nominal measured block dimensions. Validate against source nominal CoR_Housner and compare against source processed Angular_CoR from thita_dot_x (column 10).
metrics: Per-row signed error, trial mean/median/RMSE and group aggregates; primary all first finite angular-ratio entries per unique trial, secondary all finite entries. Retain nonfinite rows as missing; do not discard large finite errors.
duplicate_policy: Fingerprint Singular_data and HalfCycle_and_Impact_data together. Report repeated files as separate source trial IDs but do not double-count exact duplicates in primary metrics. Data rows within trials are correlated.
limits: Housner is an established ideal no-slip instantaneous pivot-transfer comparator, not our complete directional constitutive law or a measured material coefficient. Source nominal inertia is geometric, not a measured full tensor. Positive/negative effective geometry and fc=0.7 energy corrections are output-derived/assumed and must not be used as independent inputs.
